title: Duckzi's Opossums
description: This project adds Opossums to your minecraft world!
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84cf1aacdab90c31a993a1df1e697a578c59e62e.png)
# ABOUT
Duckzi's Opossum adds one new versatile mob to the pool: Opossums! They can be tamed, bred, annoying and so much more! This is one part of a series of mods: Duckzi's Critters.

# REQUIREMENTS
For this mod to work as intended, make sure to download the latest match version of [GeckoLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)!
# FUNCTIONS

<details>
<summary>Spawning</summary>

Opossums spawn mainly near villages, but also will spawn in forests and plains.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Breeding</summary>

To breed two opossums, use apples!

</details>

<details>
<summary>Taming</summary>

To tame an opossum, use sweet berries. It may take several.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Evil Behavior...</summary>

Opossums are attracted to dropped items, they will eat them. They will then keep said items in their inventory.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Tamed Behavior</summary>

Once tamed, you may access an opossums inventory. The sit button is located in the top left, and its rightmost slot is its cosmetic slot, changing its appearance on when holding certain items.

</details>
